Good morning Eduardo,

Thanks for checking in. I have your order Shop····, placed October 27, for the Power Kit.

It is paid and still with our warehouse. The P. Kit is waiting on stock at the moment, so it has not been picked yet and the order does not carry a ship date I can give you. Rather than guess at one, I have asked the team to confirm the restock date for it, and a colleague is picking that up today and will come back to you here with the date.

You can also follow incoming stock on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

As soon as it ships, the tracking number goes straight to this email address.

If the order you meant is a different one, just send me the order number and I will look at that one instead.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi, I know you have been busy but do you have any info on this shipping?

Thanks,

Ed
Handed to the team · Chased again by the customer; still no ship date and no reply since the first fl

Hi Ed,

Thanks for following up, and sorry you had to chase this.

Here is exactly where it stands. Your Power Kit on Shop···· is at our Tennessee warehouse queue, and the units currently on the shelf there are already allocated to earlier orders. A further batch of Power Kits is on its way into that warehouse now, and yours ships as soon as it is checked in. I do not have a confirmed landing date yet, so I am not going to guess one at you.

You can follow that incoming shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I have put this in front of the team again for a firm date, and a colleague is picking it up today and will reply in this thread. Either way, the moment it ships you get the tracking number by email automatically, without having to ask.

Sorry again for the wait on such a small item.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
